newsitem.title: GERMANY: German K&M Moebel says will issue shares at 20 dmk.
newsitem.headline: German K&M Moebel says will issue shares at 20 dmk.

text.p: German furniture manufacturer K&M Moebel AG said on Sunday that its new shares would be issued at a price of 20 marks per share.
The group said in a statement that the issue price was determined after the bookbuilding period had ended. The range for the new issue's price had been set between 18 and 23 marks.
The issue, managed by Union Bank of Switzerland and Westdeutsche Landesbank Griozentrale, was oversubscribed, the furniture group said.
The new shares will begin trading on the bourse on April 25.
